controller_mapping.restart_run: Start, select Restart Run, then confirm with A

commands.command: PATH=<cached pinned uv 0.9.24>:$PATH GODOT_BIN=<official Godot 4.7.1 Mono> ./scripts/check.sh

acceptance_comparisons.observed: RT accelerates, LT applies service brake, and left-stick X steers. Left-stick Y is unbound from propulsion. Every generated joypad event targets any connected device rather than device 0.

acceptance_comparisons.criterion: analog trigger polarity and per-profile deadzones
acceptance_comparisons.observed: Twenty-three focused Core cases cover unipolar trigger clamping, wrong-polarity rejection, deadzone rescaling, independent full-scale RT/LT, and deterministic initial-state construction across Accessible, Balanced, and Raw.

Official-engine tests exercise R3 camera toggle, LB rear view, Y recover, Start pause, D-pad navigation, A confirmation, B cancellation, controller focus loss, disconnect, and nonzero-device reconnect.

acceptance_comparisons.criterion: recover in place remains distinct from restart run
acceptance_comparisons.observed: Y recovers at the current route point without changing route progress. Restart Run is selected through the Start menu and requires a second A confirmation before rebuilding the initial route, transform, motion, timers, camera, economy, condition, enforcement, and deterministic seed.

acceptance_comparisons.criterion: restart returns to the true run start
acceptance_comparisons.observed: The live restart test first advances route progress, then confirms exact initial route distance, initial transform and orientation, zero transition motion, chase camera, initial cash and seed; restart_count increments while recover_count does not.

acceptance_comparisons.criterion: hold-to-look-behind works in chase and cockpit without changing camera mode or stored look
acceptance_comparisons.observed: LB and keyboard B smoothly blend to a rearward yaw while held and promptly return on release. Tests cover chase, cockpit, reversing, right/left free look, and switching views while rear look remains held.

acceptance_comparisons.criterion: cockpit view has a believable unobstructed windshield sightline
acceptance_comparisons.observed: The cockpit camera now uses the authored driver-eye anchor directly with a 0.05 m near clip. Cabin, roof-spine, and solid graybox interior meshes use a cockpit-excluded layer while remaining visible to chase. The retained 1280x720 render shows clear road sightline and one hood edge without the duplicate roof/interior layer.

acceptance_comparisons.criterion: save-resume and deterministic automation remain intact
acceptance_comparisons.observed: The camera gate's resume-equivalence scenario passed, the driving and camera semantic tests passed, and the complete M0 suite passed 115 C# tests, 78 map tests, 13 PlayGodot unit tests, Ruff, and official-engine smoke.

acceptance_comparisons.criterion: required first-party M0 gate passes for the verified working tree
acceptance_comparisons.observed: Doctor confirmed pinned tools; the zero-warning build, all automated suites, and official Godot smoke passed against the working tree based on 4bfc2d498a64d251289ca3b1bb248affa6879236.

failure_logs.failure: A focused Core command was first run with --no-build after editing the tests and executed stale binaries.
failure_logs.recovery: The project was rebuilt and all 23 focused Core cases passed.

failure_logs.failure: The WSL shell could not discover the installed Windows tools, and the system uv was 0.11.29 rather than the pinned 0.9.24.
failure_logs.recovery: Verification moved to Git Bash with the cached pinned uv 0.9.24 prepended; doctor then passed every tool check.

failure_logs.failure: The first full controller run exposed programmatic joypad bindings restricted to device 0.
failure_logs.recovery: Every generated joypad event now uses device -1, and live tests passed with a nonzero controller ID plus disconnect/reconnect.

failure_logs.failure: Initial restart assertions sampled the freshly reconstructed rigid body after its first physics settling frame.
failure_logs.recovery: Restart records both transition-exact motion and current physics state; tests prove exact zero transition motion without hiding subsequent deterministic settling.

failure_logs.failure: The first cockpit capture after excluding cabin and roof still exposed the solid graybox interior as a duplicate exterior layer.
failure_logs.recovery: The cockpit-only mask also excludes the solid interior placeholder while chase retains all three meshes; the rebuilt render and semantic test passed.

failure_logs.failure: Three final handoff runs reached CANNONBALL_SMOKE_OK but then crashed during Godot managed finalization after native teardown, with leaked SurfaceTool and PackedScene wrappers in the log.
failure_logs.recovery: The input-map temporary wrappers, existing mesh-builder wrappers, and Hero GT scene wrapper now use explicit deterministic disposal. The focused controller gate and a fresh complete M0 gate then passed, including clean Godot process shutdown.

recovery_result: All bounded controller, restart, rear-view, cockpit-sightline, save-resume, focused, and complete M0 automation is green. P0-018 remains verified_local rather than complete solely because dependency P0-017 still awaits the Q-029 owner camera-comfort decision.
